title: Bounded subsets of ℝⁿ are covered by O(r⁻ⁿ) closed r-balls centred in the set
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let K ⊆ ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) be bounded. Then there is a constant C ∈ ℝ such that for every r ∈ ℝ with 0 < r ≤ 1 there is a finite set s ⊆ K with K ⊆ ⋃_{x∈s} B̄(x,r) (closed Euclidean balls) and card(s)·rⁿ ≤ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Rn n)), Bornology.IsBounded K → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → ∃ s : Finset (Rn n), (↑s : Set (Rn n)) ⊆ K ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ s, closedBall x r ∧ (s.card : ℝ) * r ^ n ≤ C
